verdict.rationale: Intel's own spec page for the 285K lists the AI frameworks supported by its CPU: OpenVINO, WindowsML, DirectML, ONNX RT and WebNN. Intel's oneAPI docs also describe oneDNN and PyTorch optimizations for Core Ultra series 2 and Arc GPUs, and VTune profiling for its NPUs. Together these show both a mainstream runtime (ONNX Runtime) and the vendor's own stack documenting support for this silicon. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of local-AI runtime use on this chip, explicit per-runtime documentation of GPU/NPU (not just CPU) support for this SKU, and any mention of llama.cpp or MLX.

support.subject: As a developer, mainstream local-AI runtimes target this silicon — llama.cpp, MLX, ONNX Runtime, or the vendor's own AI software stack document support for its CPU, GPU, or NPU

citations.quote: AI Software Frameworks Supported by CPU OpenVINO™, WindowsML, DirectML, ONNX RT, WebNN

Maximize AI PC inference capabilities from large language models (LLM) to image generation with Intel® oneAPI Deep Neural Network Library (oneDNN) and PyTorch optimizations for Intel® Core™ Ultra processors (series 2) and Intel® Arc™ GPUs.
Optimize performance on client GPUs and NPUs from Intel with new analysis tool features in Intel® VTune™ Profiler.
